lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the branchial region, arranged in roughly four to five horizontal rows with consistent inter-blob spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating localized intensity maxima at the points of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a high-contrast transition from a bright superior edge to a shadowed inferior edge, extending from the post-cephalic region toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of low-luminance, elongated pixel structures representing associated ichthyofauna is visible in the water column ventral to the primary pectoral fin.
